record.headline: The Teams plan page dropped its $40 per full dev seat fee and now shows only $80 per month, in a version of the page that flipped between two layouts during the run.
rows: Per full dev seat per month

record.read: Removing the seat fee moves Teams from a base plus seat price toward a flat price with shared credits, which would lower the cost for larger teams. Because the page showed two versions, this may be a test rather than a decided change.
record.caveat: The page showed two different layouts in one run; the new Teams card also adds Devin Bots access. Treat as a possible A/B test.
